Q4. What do my population/player
type/player reads tell me?

This player fires post-flop bets
frequently on all streets. His WWSF is
high and he clearly isn't one to play fit-
or-fold on the later streets. The Kc on
the turn is a perceived scare card on
which many Villains will bluff a wide
range and Hero shouldn't have too much
Kx in his own range after he calls the
flop c-bet. This is a card that is much
better for Villain's range than Hero's. All
of this makes Villain fairly likely to be
bluffing this river with a wide range of
